stem:
Lalit looks at the diagram of quadrilateral $PQRS$. All four sides carry the same tick mark. No right-angle mark is shown.

Which claim correctly classifies $PQRS$?

options.text: Call $PQRS$ a rhombus while the four sides are allowed to be unequal.
$PQRS$ is a rhombus and a parallelogram; it is not a square because no right angle is shown.
Being a parallelogram forces the four equal side lengths on $PQRS$.
Call $PQRS$ a square under the same marks, with right angles that are not shown.

teacher.key_rationale: Equal sides make a rhombus (hence a parallelogram). Without a right-angle mark it is not shown to be a square. Allowing unequal sides, reversing parallelogram→equal sides, or forcing a square miss the classification.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source kite as rhombus PQRS with equal-side tick marks and no right-angle marks.
